purpose: Uniform descriptive assembly-derived evidence annotation; never a chromosome-cap, somatic, full-path or dosage detector.

tract_rule.bounds: Union of qualifying 100bp windows, then trim to the first/last motif-covered base; report continuous coverage and canonical bases.

reference_ambiguous_base_policy: Any non-ACGT base in the requested outward comparison leaves the reference comparison uncallable.
direct_context: Any intervening selected source alignment is retained; MAPQ>=20 pieces establish a donor-route candidate, and lower MAPQ pieces add ambiguity unless they lie entirely within the repeat tract.
source_binding_policy: Current FASTA hashes identify observed bytes only. Bound source claims require the supported upstream alignment-generation content binding; a selected-PAF-to-raw-PAF cache binding alone is insufficient.

method_provenance.relationship: Independent exact-motif coverage implementation using the fixed H3 descriptive settings; does not implement Telogator2 clustering, denoising, or allele assignment.

display_qualification.outward_partition: The strong extension or donor-route display requires the existing primary span and canonical-base minima on the outward-only partition; keep full-tract measurements even when this qualification fails.
display_qualification.reference_completeness: Keep requested and available lengths; a reference-end-clipped comparison cannot support the nonreference-extension display.
display_qualification.review_correction: These are evidence-partition/completeness qualifications. The motif detector, tract thresholds, H3 assays and ONT settings are unchanged.
display_qualification.reference_fragmentation: Intervening pieces whose ordered transitions are all reference-compatible retain the route but cannot create a donor-route display. This does not itself establish that the repeat matches the reference.
